description: Create original songs from a prompt or your own lyrics, then work with audio inside ChatGPT. Browse your existing music with cover art, listen to available versions, and refresh results through interactive cards. Vocuno can trim, mix, master, separate stems, clean up recordings, convert voices and file formats, detect tempo, and extend a song. It connects to your existing Vocuno account so generated and processed audio stays in your library.

defaultPrompt: Show my latest song with cover art and playable versions.
Show my latest songs as interactive music cards.
Show my existing separated stems so I can listen to each part.
